titulo: NVIDIA: $40.4 billion in buybacks, about 42,000 on staff
caption:
NVIDIA: $40.4 billion in buybacks, about 42,000 on staff

NVIDIA, Nov 12, 2026 (Press release, Nov 12): "NVIDIA’s strength has always come from its people"
NVIDIA's press release of Nov 12, 2026 (8-K, Exhibit 99.1) quotes its interim CEO and CFO. The buyback and headcount figures come from NVIDIA's 10-K for fiscal 2026.

Its last full fiscal year: $40.4 billion in buybacks to shareholders, fiscal 2026. $40.4 billion in share repurchases in fiscal 2026 (year ended Jan 25, 2026), per NVIDIA's 10-K; $974 million in dividends not counted.
The math: $40.4 billion SHAREHOLDER BUYBACKS (2026) ÷ about 42,000 employees (10-K) = about $961,904 SHAREHOLDER BUYBACKS PER HEAD. The employees count is approximate, per 10-K.
This is a ratio, not a payment and not a cause: the total spent on buybacks divided by the headcount. The $40.4 billion is NVIDIA's own figure for share repurchases in fiscal 2026 and does not include $974 million in dividends. About 42,000 is its headcount at the end of that fiscal year. Buybacks go to shareholders, not to employees, and NVIDIA has not linked them. A ratio, not a payment or a cause.

Words here. Dollars there. (Our take.)

Send this to someone who keeps hearing that people come first.

Synthetic voice. Sources: SEC EDGAR · NVIDIA (8-K), Nov 12, 2026; SEC EDGAR · NVIDIA (10-K FY2026), Feb 25, 2026.
